title: Bamboo drawer dividers
text: Bamboo drawer dividers. I purchased these not really knowing how I was going to use them but I was hopeful.  I LOVE them.  They are spring loaded - press on and in - press on again and lift out.  I have this wanky silverware drawer and I can't get a tray that fits.  SO.... I decided to recycle the old tray and kind of make the drawer the tray.  It couldn't be better for me.  The picture I have included doesn't show the drawer pulled all the way out - but I have utilized the entire drawer and my forks and spoons are no longer a tangled mess - as I have placed the dividers closely together so everything stands up (except the knives - which is fine).  I am just in love with how this ended up.  The dividers appear to be solid bamboo.  There are non-slip rubber tips on each end.  The edges are a tad sharp - but so far so good.  If I could change on thing - it would be ro round the edges just a tad.  They are super easy to adjust.  If you're thinking about something new in your silverware drawer, these are definitely worth the try.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and as always (around 25 years worth), I never have accepted ANY compensation of ANY kind for my honest opinions and experiences.
